choice.basis: The y-axis is inverted (0 at top, 8000 at bottom), so the visual downward slope of the blue line from Feb 24 to Mar 14, 2020, represents a rapid increase in the number of hospitalized patients from near 0 to near 8000. This supports routing to surge-capacity planning.
choice.option_label: Route to hospital surge-capacity planning guidance for rapidly increasing COVID-19 inpatient demand
